name: magpie-kt-agent
description: Magpie agent plugin: put KohakuTerrarium (kt) on magpie's Agents page and write the model into kt's llm_profiles.yaml

summary.en: Adds KohakuTerrarium to magpie's Agents page: pick a model there and magpie writes it into kt's llm_profiles.yaml, gateway address and reasoning level included.
summary.zh: 把 KohakuTerrarium 加进 magpie 的 Agents 页：在 magpie 里选模型，magpie 就把模型、网关地址和思考档位写进 kt 的 llm_profiles.yaml。
